verdicts.rationale: All four members are the single-volume book 'Not by Genes Alone' by Richerson and Boyd. Year 2006 vs 2008 and ISBN 9780226712123 vs 9780226712130 are hardcover/paperback printings of the same edition; not a substantively different publication. None is indexed.

verdicts.id: mind body identity privacy and categories
verdicts.rationale: Both are Rorty's 'Mind-Body Identity, Privacy, and Categories', Review of Metaphysics vol 19, 1965. Same article, author name ordering only differs.

'Parallel Distributed Processing' is a two-volume work. The survivor (volume '1 and 2') and rumelhart1988parallel (misc, same DOI) are the combined set. But rumelhart1986mcclelland is explicitly volume 1 (ISBN 9780262181204) and mcclelland1986distributed is volume 2 (ISBN 9780262631129) — distinct individual volumes of the multi-volume work, so they should not be merged into the set entry.
